headline: SecMark Consultancy Limited: Acquisition
sum: Acquisition — Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 the Board of Directors of the Company, on July 03, 2026, has, inter alia, approved the incorporation of a proposed Wholly Owned Subsidiary of the Company.
